chunks: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.

key_terms.اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ: Allah, the Eternal Refuge / The Self-Sufficient

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning and significance of Surah Al-Ikhlas in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights Surah Al-Ikhlas as the essence of Tawhid, a concept central to Shia theology regarding the absolute oneness of God. The chapter underscores its status as 'one-third of the Quran' due to its comprehensive declaration of divine attributes, serving as a foundational text for both liturgical recitation and theological affirmation of God's uniqueness.
